_: The mechanism D23 prohibits, and the words that count as acknowledging the ban.
WHY THIS IS DATA: the D23 interlock counts occurrences of the mechanism's name in .rs files
under crates/. A rule that REFUSES the mechanism has to name it, so literals in the rule made
the interlock report THE RULE ITSELF as a violation - 'prlintrules.rs (0 -> 28)'. The interlock
cannot tell a file that IMPLEMENTS a mechanism from one that DETECTS it.
The fix is not to weaken the interlock and not to obfuscate the literal. The interlock's own
code already handles this with a split constant; this file is the rule's half of the same
solution, and it follows the patterns file added for the prep rules.
`acknowledgements` exists so a body that SAYS the ban is honoured does not produce a finding.
